about: The owner's answers of 2026-11-26 10:02 ICT on the outlines of the commercial screen's codes (DATA_METHOD.md §2d, release 0.5.2), read by scripts/rule-outlines.py revise. The questions were Claude's (chat, 2026-11-26 about 08:10 ICT, with the tick sheet 02-CityMETER__outline-rule-screen-check__v1__2026-11-26 and its 17 review images).

ticks.asked: The 17 outlines of 0.5.0 that reach over 1 km from their reference point; Claude's recommendation per code, which answer 1 takes as given (Inference: “ตามที่พี่แนะนำ” = as recommended).

buildingsV4.rule: the owner's rule of 2026-11-24 (§2c) and the seeds of 0.5.0 (§2d), with the drawing's option cm: inside a unit the buildings are V4's in place of OpenStreetMap's; ground stays the basemap's

CMN-TH-BAFFB5235F.why: Inference (Claude): his words name the market, the shops round it and ตลาดไอยรา; the market's own area joins whole ('take'), the shops are the buildings the rule reaches within 250 m of it, and the corridor includes the line to ตลาดไอยรา (about 230 m south of the market's edge). 250 m reaches the shophouses on Phahonyothin west of the market; a wider corridor would take in more housing round it.
